Dear Madam,

Subject: Nomination /Change of Nomination of Nodal Officer to function as Chief Data Officer for
the Kochi Metro Rail Limited as per National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy

(NDSAP)

e

The undersigned is directed to refer to Cabinet Secretariat's 0.0. No. 5{32)/2010-EG-1(pt.) dated
18-07-2012, on the above mentioned subject and to say that:

1. Shri D. Sunil has been nominated as Nodal Officer to function as Chief Data Officer for the
purposes of coordinating and facilitating the release of datasets from Kochi Metro Rail Limited on
Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India (http://data.gov.in) as per NDSAP. The details of Chief
Data Officer are as under:
